title: EmailCampaignsPostRequestBodyContentApplicationJsonSchemaSender
description: Sender details including id or email and name (optional). Only one of either Sender’s email or Sender’s ID shall be passed in one request at a time. Passing both `email` and `id` will result in an error. For example: **{"name":"xyz", "email":"example@abc.com"}** or **{"name":"xyz", "id":123}**

email.description: Sender email. Must be a valid email address. Cannot be used together with `id` in the same request.

id.description: Select the sender for the campaign on the basis of sender id. Cannot be used together with `email` in the same request. _In order to select a sender with a specific pool of IPs, dedicated IP users shall pass id (instead of email)._
